CART QUEST

◀ ▶ thrust · ▼ brake · Esc pause · physics is real: F = ma

A Smart Cart companion game · city models by Kay Lousberg (CC0)

How to play

Drive with ◀ ▶ (or A/D) — you apply real force, and F = ma does the rest. ▼ brakes. Hills steal and return energy; crests can launch you airborne.

Fight by ramming: you destroy an enemy only if your kinetic energy (KE = ½mv², live on your HUD) beats the number over its head. Too slow and you'll bounce off and lose battery.

Answer the question gates to pass — correct answers pay points, XP and battery.

Collect ◈ to spend in the shop: stronger motor, slicker wheels, bigger battery, shields, a coin magnet — and new car bodies.

Level up to unlock new worlds. Three stars need par score — replay missions to master them.
